topic: remove crayon marks from a leather bag
core_question: How do I get crayon marks off a leather bag?
answer_summary: Dab a small amount of plain mayonnaise (or non-gel white toothpaste) onto the crayon marks, let it sit briefly, then rub gently with a soft cloth and wipe clean — the oils help lift the wax-based crayon.
